fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: All residence halls open Aug 15 (move-in Aug 12-14); Classes Aug 17 - Nov 30, 2026; Fall Break Oct 3-6; Final Exams Dec 2-9, 2026; Residence halls close Dec 10, 2026.
fall_term_dates.notes: Exam and residence hall move-in/close dates per ECU 2026-27 university calendar & housing schedule.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Residence halls reopen Jan 7, 2027; Classes Jan 11 - Apr 27, 2027; Spring Break Mar 6-14, 2027; Final Exams Apr 29 - May 6, 2027; Residence halls close May 7, 2027.
spring_term_dates.notes: Exam and residence hall move-in/close dates per ECU 2026-27 university calendar & housing schedule.

tuition_model.notes: https://global-affairs.ecu.edu/incoming-exchange-students/ does not publicly specify tuition-waiver terms for partner agreements.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from ECU 2026-27 on-campus undergraduate Housing + Food Cost of Attendance divided across 10 academic months (two 5-month semesters): Continuing UG $8,313 housing + $3,088 food = $11,401/yr ($1,140.10/month); Entering UG $6,699 housing + $5,521 food = $12,220/yr ($1,222.00/month). Excludes books/supplies ($1,570/yr), personal ($2,067/yr), and health insurance.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1 USD = 1.0 USD on 2026-11-15 (native USD); 5-month semester midpoint of ECU 2026-27 on-campus undergraduate Housing + Food COA ($11,401/yr continuing = $5,700.50/sem to $12,220/yr entering = $6,110.00/sem; midpoint $5,905.25/semester), excluding books/personal expenses and health insurance.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: J-1 exchange visitors are federally required to carry J-1 compliant medical insurance for the full DS-2019 period (home country policies are generally not accepted; enrollment in an ECU/UNC-approved plan is mandatory; degree-seeking Student Blue SHIP is estimated at $1,312/sem UG or $2,366.50/sem GR). On-campus residents are typically required to carry a residential meal plan (Purple plans $2,517+tax/semester).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Student Blue semester estimate and Purple meal plan rate sourced from ECU Student Financial Services / Campus Living.

housing_availability.notes: Page states: 'Exchange students are required to live on campus. Spots are specifically set aside for exchange students.'

housing_notes.value: Incoming exchange students are required to live on campus in designated reserved spots and may move in one day prior to orientation. ECU residence hall rates range ~$3,046.50 (standard) to $3,576.00/semester (College Hill Suites), plus required residential meal plans (~$2,517+tax/semester).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Requires J-1 Exchange Visitor visa with Form DS-2019 issued by ECU Office of Global Affairs after acceptance and verification of financial means (30-day post-program grace period applies; additional financial/insurance proof required for J-2 dependents).

english_course_list_url.notes: Instruction is in English; graduate catalog at https://catalog.ecu.edu/graduate/.

credit_system_and_load.notes: US semester credit-hour system; J-1 exchange students must maintain a full-time course load, though specific numeric minimum exchange credits are not published on https://global-affairs.ecu.edu/incoming-exchange-students/ (12-credit figure on getting-started/ applies to outgoing ECU financial aid).
